generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of snowy street (雪天街道). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a quiet neighbourhood just after snowfall, viewed down a gently receding pavement. A bundled resident wearing the scarf, gloves and snow boots holds one snow shovel near a small cleared patch. Position the grit bin against a wall, icicles along a porch roof and a simple snowman in the middle distance. One parked snowplough remains in the upper background while strong tyre tracks curve through the lower foreground. Soft blue winter daylight with subtle warm window glow, undisturbed snow texture, no active traffic and no repeated shovels or clothing accessories.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: snow-covered pavement, snow shovel, road-grit bin, knitted scarf, woollen gloves, snow boots, snowman, icicle, parked snowplough, tyre tracks in snow.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
